title: Draft Activity Record
description: One logical record in a project's Activity Ledger. The chain hash and the payload identity are computed over this canonical logical record alone, never over the physical frame that stores it.

event_id.description: Preallocated by the transaction that appends it, so a replayed recovery converges on one record instead of two.

previous_hash.description: The record this one links onto, or the ledger's genesis hash.

kind.description: A name from the frozen v1 vocabulary. Closed: every entry maps to a named audit fact and a named journal mechanism. There is deliberately no PublicationAttempted.

subject.description: The graph object the event is about, when it has one.

recorded_at.description: Nanoseconds since the epoch, supplied by the fact rather than read at append time — an append is idempotent on its payload, and reading the clock again would break that.

metadata.description: Everything else the event needs to be understood without the store that produced it. Redacted before it is written.
